prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is the DESIGN REFERENCE: our current sprite of this exact creature. Keep its design, colours, silhouette and equipment; redraw it as larger, more detailed modern pixel art.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 56-72 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: small hunched green goblin with long pointed ears, a big hooked nose, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, wearing a ragged brown leather vest and a rope belt, bare green arms and feet, holding a short rusty dagger. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its face (eyes, mouth or muzzle) is clearly readable in every cell, drawn at the same sprite-pixel size as the body.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, lunging forward and stabbing with the dagger held out toward the heroes, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back, flinching with eyes squeezed shut and the dagger arm thrown back, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render.
